utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. Just a strong box of assorted screws, a screwdriver set, and if you have any spare tape, bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring screws, a screwdriver set, and any spare tape I have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I need the details first—what exactly needs repairing, and where do we drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm what’s broken and the drop-off spot? I’d rather not guess and bring the wrong stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m with you — let’s get the exact list and the drop-off address first so we don’t waste a trip.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, just that it’s this Saturday by the community center, and I could use help sorting tools and donations. If you can swing by, that’d be a huge help—sorry, I keep losing track of the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can swing by Saturday and help sort things out. Just remind me what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out too and let folks know while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan as I talk to people, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably show up a bit late, but I can still pitch in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries at all—just come when you can, Dane. We’ll still put your help to good use.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I'll head over as soon as I can and help where needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — let’s keep it simple and make a clear plan for the repair drive. What time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s start at 10 a.m. at the community center, and I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — 10 a.m. at the community center works for me. I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive today. Just tell me when and where to meet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you meet me at the community center at 3 PM?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — that’d be a big help. I’m keeping track of who wants to pitch in, so send me their names and I’ll note where they can help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send you names plus what each person wants to help with.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you want me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you start by checking which homes need urgent repairs and jotting down their addresses? Then we’ll sort the list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check which homes need urgent repairs and write down the addresses, then I’ll sort the list by priority.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready for the repair drive—just tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we have.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great—just send me the list, and I’ll grab whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll send it over now, and if anything’s short I’ll mark it clearly. We should be set once you’ve grabbed the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout so far—people are bringing tools, parts, and all sorts of things. If you’re heading over, I’d go soon before the tables get too crowded.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I should probably head over soon, then. Thanks for the heads-up, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—better to get there while there’s still room to sort through everything. Let me know if you spot anything useful!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the details first—what time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 3:30 at the community center, and if you can, bring a small flashlight and a screwdriver. If you don’t have those, just come as you are—there’ll be extras.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps. I’ll plan to be there at 3:30 and bring a flashlight and screwdriver if I can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what’s the repair drive need?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they still need tools, donated parts, and a few volunteers to help sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I'll bring some tools and see if I can spare a little time to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass the word along about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep spreading the word and update everyone if the plan changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I might've missed the details—what’s happening with it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s just a small neighborhood repair drive to help folks with things they can’t fix on their own. I’ve been meaning to keep it low-key, but I can tell you the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I got a bit turned around. What kind of repairs are people bringing in?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad folks are pitching in for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just bring whatever tools you’ve got handy, and we’ll put them to work. If you find anything else useful, I’m happy to borrow it too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll bring my toolbox by and see if there’s anything else useful at home.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can keep track of the requests. What’s the first thing you’d like me to add?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Please start with the front porch light on Maple Street—it’s been flickering for days.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Got it — I’ll add the front porch light on Maple Street first and keep an eye on it. If you notice anything else, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and what’s needed first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the timing and a quick list of what’s needed as soon as I have it. We’d love to have you join in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that works for me. Just send the timing and list when you have it, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm — is the repair drive still happening today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details now, but I don’t want to guess—can you remind me of the time and place for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure either — I just want to confirm it’s still on today. If you find the time and place, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs doing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with that—let’s start by listing the urgent fixes first, then we can sort the rest by day. I’ll swing by late and help once the plan’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. Let’s make the urgent list first, then pick a start time for late today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moving along — folks have been dropping off tools, screws, and a few spare parts. If you need anything specific, I can keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be lovely — I’m still piecing things together. If you hear about any small hand tools or extra screws, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — that’s kind of you. If you can help sort tools or greet folks, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can sort tools and greet folks. Just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time window are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. Let’s aim for Saturday morning, maybe 9 to 11.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning from 9 to 11 works for me. I’ll help line things up around school schedules.
